announcements.headline: Operational and corporate update
announcements.insight: Shares remain suspended following the final ICSID award. Shareholders must await further developments regarding the Slovenia ECT claim resolution.

announcements.headline: ICSID Tribunal issues Final Award
announcements.insight: Ascent Resources plc faces suspension following the ICSID Tribunal's Final Award. This legal conclusion likely precipitates the trading halt announced in July.

announcements.headline: Suspension - Ascent Resources plc
announcements.insight: Ascent Resources plc shares are suspended following the June delay to final results. Shareholders should await the next update regarding the Slovenia ECT claim.

announcements.headline: Update on Slovenia ECT Claim
announcements.insight: Ascent Resources updates its Slovenia ECT claim following the June suspension. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding this legal dispute.

announcements.headline: Delay to Final Results and Temporary Suspension
announcements.insight: Ascent Resources faces a delay to final results and temporary suspension of its shares. Shareholders should monitor for updates regarding the resumption of trading.
